lines.text: Two hundred tasks, five workspaces, and you need the one about the invoice bug.
So you scroll. Open a workspace, scan the titles, give up, and open the next workspace.
Press Command K, or Control K on Windows, and a search box opens over everything.
Type the word invoice. It searches titles and descriptions, right from your device.
N files a new task, from anywhere in the app, without hunting for a plus button.
W jumps to a workspace. A quick picker opens, so you type a few letters and press enter.
M jumps to a machine the same way, so a remote terminal is only a few keystrokes away.
And question mark lists every shortcut, so you never need to memorize the lot at once.
Press W for the workspace, N for a new task, type the title, and enter files it. Four keys.
When an agent asks for permission, you can decide without hunting the mouse for the button.
Less hunting through lists, more time on the work that matters.
What is the one thing you always lose track of with agents? Tell us, or try the keys at Agent R Q dot com.
